episode.title: The OC Pack — Episode 6: Three Acres of Freedom: Inside Irvine Central Bark

headline: 5 dog things to do in Orange County this weekend.
intro: Santa photos in Lake Forest, a makers market in Old Town Tustin, and three good places to run, splash and hike. Here is the weekend:

picks.detail: Saturday, 1 to 5 PM at The Pet Adoption Center of Orange County, 24331 Muirlands Boulevard, Suites E and F. Bring your dog for a festive photo with Santa at this annual holiday gathering. Check the center site before you go for photo pricing and any reservation details.
picks.name: Pet Photos with Santa, Lake Forest

picks.detail: Sunday, 11 AM to 5 PM at 245 El Camino Real. This outdoor makers show fills Old Town with local vendors, food trucks and DIY crafts, and leashed dogs are welcome at Patchwork outdoor shows. Start at the info booth to pick up a scavenger hunt card.
picks.name: Patchwork Show, Old Town Tustin

picks.detail: Open daily 5 AM to 10 PM on Pacific Coast Highway between Seapoint Avenue and Goldenwest Street. Dogs stay leashed in the parking lots and on the upper bluff, and the sand is leash optional for dogs with strong recall. Metered parking fills early on weekends, so go in the morning.
picks.name: Huntington Dog Beach

picks.detail: Saturday and Sunday, 6:30 AM to 10 PM at 6405 Oak Canyon. Nearly three acres of fenced off-leash play, with a separate area for small or frail dogs, plus water, seating and lighting. Weekends get busy, so early visits suit shy dogs best.
picks.name: Irvine Central Bark

picks.detail: A 2.5 mile loop around the reservoir at Peters Canyon Regional Park, 8548 Canyon View Avenue. Dogs are welcome on a leash of six feet or less, and the park is open 7 AM to sunset. Parking is $3 for the day. Bring water, as shade is limited on the loop.
picks.name: Peters Canyon Lake View Loop, Orange

subject: Your Friday 5: dog things for this weekend · The OC Pack

trailGuide.leash: Required at all times, six foot maximum
trailGuide.name: Peters Canyon Lake View Loop, Orange
trailGuide.note: About 2.5 miles of wide dirt trail around the reservoir. Trails can close for up to three days after rain, so check OC Parks alerts if the weather turns.
trailGuide.parking: Main lot at 8548 Canyon View Avenue, $3 per day; lot closes at sunset
trailGuide.shade: Limited shade, with open sunny stretches around the reservoir; go early

vetPlaybook.detail: Which shots are due matters more than the visit itself. Core vaccines, boosters your dog is due for, the exam fee and add-ons like bordetella for boarding or daycare all change the total. Ask which vaccines are required, which are optional for your dog's lifestyle, and get the list in writing before the visit.
vetPlaybook.title: Vaccines: what actually drives the bill
